problem: The arrival station moved the local solver's low bound to 12:30 before applying daily_minutes, omitting fixed intercity transport and origin-city access from the daily elapsed-time limit.

cases: Known origin access and fixed bridge consume the daily budget
A fitting cross-city schedule stays within the whole-day elapsed cap
Estimated access alone cannot prove an infeasible daily limit
An outbound fixed bridge's end must also respect the daily limit

fix: Daily bounds start from the earliest included fixed bridge/access event; a separate relaxed bound using only confirmed events distinguishes proofs from estimated-route uncertainty. Candidate and route checkpoints remain compatible, while v6 schedule checkpoints are rejected under v7.
evidence_boundaries: The paid v6 report is preserved; it is not relabeled as satisfying the 600-minute cap.
No successful provider scene was generated again and no campaign ledger was reset.
The six-case holdout was run once on v6 before this separate live-output discovery; it was not used to tune v7 or rerun as unseen evidence.
The revalidated output is still degraded/unverified with incomplete venue, lodging, dining and price facts.
